description: This header file defines internal functions, data structures, and object interfaces related to ASN.1 CRL (Certificate Revocation List) processing within the Cisco ASN.1 code generation framework. It includes function prototypes for creating, managing, and verifying CRL objects, as well as related structures for handling revocation certificates and associated components.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CRLCreateChildAttr
methods.description: Creates attribute object for a specified child index in CRL object.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CRLGetChildName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a child element at a specified index in CRL object.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CRLCreateChildObject
methods.description: Creates a child object within the CRL structure at a specified index.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CRLGetTbsCertList
methods.description: Returns the TBSCertList component of the CRL.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CRLGetSigatureAlgorithm
methods.description: Retrieves the signature algorithm used in the CRL.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CRLGetSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature of the CRL.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CRLBeforeDecodingChild
methods.description: Hook executed before decoding a child element of the CRL.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CRLAfterDecodingChild
methods.description: Hook executed after decoding a child element of the CRL.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CRLAfterDecoding
methods.description: Hook executed after decoding the entire CRL structure.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CRLGetIssuerHandle
methods.description: Returns the issuer handle of the CRL.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CRLGetThisUpdateTime
methods.description: Retrieves the 'thisUpdate' timestamp from the CRL.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CRLGetNextUpdateTime
methods.description: Retrieves the 'nextUpdate' timestamp from the CRL.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CRLVerify
methods.description: Verifies the CRL signature against a public key.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CRLIsCertRevoked
methods.description: Checks if a certificate with a specific serial number is revoked according to the CRL.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CRLEnumRevokedCert
methods.description: Enumerates revoked certificates and applies a callback function.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CRLGetSignatureType
methods.description: Returns the type of signature used in the CRL.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CRLIsCRLExpired
methods.description: Checks if the CRL is expired based on current time.
